metadata.reference: Picked birch and walnut HUD kit, exact existing wood RGB entries and dark mappings reused.
notes: Use the 1280 x 1280 primary PNGs in the game; previews_8x are exact inspection enlargements.
The 40-entry shared material palette yields 17-32 used opaque colours per piece. Simple lines intentionally use fewer shades; no dithering or filler pixels are added.
The frame has four whole 192 x 192 px corners. At 9 source px per point, its 51-52 px straight rails measure 5.67-5.78 points.
Repeat complete carved edge tiles. For non-multiple lengths, use the supplied neutral profiles for the remainder, so no moon, star or leaf is cut at a corner.
The open tab has a borderless parchment foot; overlap it with the pane at its recorded bottom_join_y. tab_closed is a transparent-backed divider only.
The speech plaque, next arrow and row divider are separate so their symbols and positions stay fixed when their parent panels resize.
The exterior canvas is transparent. Text panes are deliberately opaque, flat parchment in light mode and deep warm brown in dark mode.

window_frame.edge_mode: repeat whole canonical units; neutral end profiles fill residual space
window_frame.residual_space_policy: Distribute residual neutral pixels across n+1 gaps between n complete motif units; never crop a motif at a corner.
window_frame.preservation: Four original ornate corner crops; only their neutral 8 px joining strips are normalized. No motif is rotated, stretched or replaced.

window_title_bar.resize_instructions: Preserve both 168 px end caps; repeat the central 1 px profile horizontally at the original height.

flat_regions.name: plain tab label and open bottom

connection.assembly: Place the pane immediately below row 784; extend the same parchment under the full open span. Keep any underlying bar outline behind the tab.

tab_open.outline_exception: Open bottom parchment span has no border
tab_open.resize_instructions: Preserve the two 224 px caps with their full corner leaves and flared feet; repeat only the 1 px centre profile horizontally.

tab_closed.role: Unselected-tab divider only; no filled tab background

inset_panel.notes: Repeat the separate row_divider at the desired row positions. Pane is one solid colour.

row_divider.notes: A separate recessed line: shadow at top, lit lip at foot. No baked row count.

section_heading_ornament.notes: Keep the left star and leaf curl whole; stretch only the plain rule.

source_transform.method: isometric end pieces; undecorated centre shortened horizontally
